module_summary: Wishbone classic-to-pipelined bridge: passes request fields combinationally, issues a single strobe tracked by last_stb, and registers ack, error and read data back.

anchors.name: i_sstb
anchors.why: Upstream classic strobe; drives o_mstb and clears ack/err/last_stb when low

anchors.name: i_scyc
anchors.why: Upstream bus cycle forwarded to o_mcyc

anchors.name: i_sdata
anchors.why: Upstream write data forwarded to o_mdata

anchors.name: o_sack
anchors.why: Registered upstream ack set by i_mack, ends transfer

anchors.name: o_sdata
anchors.why: Read data register captured from i_mdata on ack

anchors.name: o_serr
anchors.why: Registered bus error; also blocks o_mcyc and o_mstb

anchors.name: o_mstb
anchors.why: Downstream pipelined strobe, suppressed after first accepted beat via last_stb

anchors.name: o_mcyc
anchors.why: Downstream bus cycle, dropped on error

anchors.name: o_mdata
anchors.why: Downstream write data copied from i_sdata

anchors.name: i_mstall
anchors.why: Downstream stall; strobe accepted when low, setting last_stb

anchors.name: i_mack
anchors.why: Downstream ack setting o_sack and capturing read data

anchors.name: i_mdata
anchors.why: Downstream read data latched into o_sdata

anchors.name: last_stb
anchors.why: Marks strobe already accepted downstream; masks o_mstb until ack/err

groups.name: Strobe control
groups.description: Issues one pipelined strobe per classic request using last_stb

groups.name: Request forwarding
groups.description: Combinational pass-through of we, address, data, select

groups.name: Response return
groups.description: Registers ack, error and read data back to classic side
